nodes.rationale: Failures retry after backoff up to the configured maximum; expired active work remains lost.

nodes.rationale: The saved comparison changes cache entries from 20 to 100 while holding workload settings constant.

nodes.label: Demand Exceeds Capacity
nodes.rationale: Expected demand is 700 arrivals per second against 500 per second of database capacity, causing a full queue and rejected requests.

nodes.label: Understand Retry Cost
nodes.rationale: The guide compares no retries against two retries at 50% failure per attempt to observe attempts, permanent failures, and successful-job latency.

nodes.label: Before and After Cache Comparison
nodes.rationale: With the same workload settings, the saved run with an 80% fixed-probability cache shows higher completion, lower p95 latency, and no failed requests.
